The '''U'Dray system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[U'Dray]].
